findings.title: The docs say that reading the source until it throws closes it
findings.claim: The docs say that reading the source until it throws closes it. That is not true for every exception the source can throw.

findings.title: The new docs say the stream's connection is shut down only once both halves are closed,…
findings.claim: The new docs say the stream's connection is shut down only once both halves are closed, and commit 3 says closing one half means it is never shut down. Both are false.

findings.title: The new stream_close() comment says _error is only set by the stop() that follows, but…
findings.claim: The new stream_close() comment says _error is only set by the stop() that follows, but several other paths set _error concurrently.

findings.title: The comment says nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready after stream_close()…
findings.claim: The comment says nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready after stream_close() starts, but stop_send_loop() still does when_all(std::move(_outgoing_queue_ready), ...). It now only receives the ready placeholder.

findings.title: The test waits on close_entered_cv without a timeout, and it releases close only on the…
findings.claim: The test waits on close_entered_cv without a timeout, and it releases close only on the success path. Any exception between sink.close() and set_value() leaves the write-buffer close parked forever.

findings.title: The test holds a reference into a growable std::vector (client_factory
findings.claim: The test holds a reference into a growable std::vector (client_factory.hooks.back()) while more negotiations can push_back into the same vector.

findings.title: The regression test does not cover the second half of the fix, which waits for…
findings.claim: The regression test does not cover the second half of the fix, which waits for `_outgoing_queue` to drain before closing. A fix that only sets `_stream_closing` would pass the test.

findings.title: Only one way into stream_close() is tested: client side, triggered by close_sink after…
findings.claim: Only one way into stream_close() is tested: client side, triggered by close_sink after the source is drained. The source-eof trigger and the server-side stream connection are not exercised.

findings.title: The test accepts the hook returning success as well as closed_error, and only asserts on…
findings.claim: The test accepts the hook returning success as well as closed_error, and only asserts on put_after_close. It never checks the PR's stated contract that send() is refused with closed_error once stream_close() has begun.

findings.title: The test wrappers override inherited behavior instead of forwarding it: buffer_size()…
findings.claim: The test wrappers override inherited behavior instead of forwarding it: buffer_size() returns a hard-coded 8192 instead of the inner sink's, and set_reuseaddr/get_reuseaddr ignore the wrapped socket. The latter is copied from rpc_socket_impl.

findings.title: The test factory mutates itself from a const negotiate() through const_cast<
findings.claim: The test factory mutates itself from a const negotiate() through const_cast<...>(this). The existing cfactory in the same file uses a `mutable` member for the same purpose.

findings.title: New doxygen \brief blocks were added above sink and source, but the old one-line…
findings.claim: New doxygen \brief blocks were added above sink and source, but the old one-line comments "// send data Out..." and "// receive data In..." were left between the doxygen and the class.

findings.title: None of the three commits has a Signed-off-by line, which the project's contribution…
findings.claim: None of the three commits has a Signed-off-by line, which the project's contribution guide requires (commit with -s for the DCO).

findings.title: stream_close() overwrites _outgoing_queue_ready with a ready future, and its comment…
findings.claim: stream_close() overwrites _outgoing_queue_ready with a ready future, and its comment says nothing else waits for it. But stop_send_loop() still consumes _outgoing_queue_ready through when_all, and suspend_for_testing() calls .get() on it, so the field now silently means two different things.

findings.title: The existing comment in stop_send_loop() explaining why _outgoing_queue_ready may be…
findings.claim: The existing comment in stop_send_loop() explaining why _outgoing_queue_ready may be exceptional is now incomplete. On stream connections it is always the ready placeholder installed by stream_close(), and the comment was not updated.

findings.title: _stream_closing is a second "may send" flag next to _error, and only send() checks it
findings.claim: _stream_closing is a second "may send" flag next to _error, and only send() checks it. error() and the other send guards check only _error: sink_impl::send_buffer, sink_impl::close, stream_close itself and client::enqueue_zero_frame.

findings.title: The lambda parameter `future<> f` in stream_close shadows the enclosing local `auto f`,…
findings.claim: The lambda parameter `future<> f` in stream_close shadows the enclosing local `auto f`, which is assigned from that same expression.

findings.title: The new _stream_closing member comment largely duplicates the comment block in…
findings.claim: The new _stream_closing member comment largely duplicates the comment block in stream_close() and points to it. The shutdown contract is also written three times: in doc/rpc-streaming.md, on rpc::sink, and on rpc::source.

findings.title: The doc calls dropping an unclosed sink "an error"
findings.claim: The doc calls dropping an unclosed sink "an error". In code, ~sink_impl runs SEASTAR_ASSERT(sink_closed()), which aborts the process. Nothing is reported to the caller.

findings.title: BOOST_REQUIRE_EQUAL(hooks
findings.claim: BOOST_REQUIRE_EQUAL(hooks.size(), 2u) hard-codes how many client-side negotiations rpc performs internally (parent plus stream), and the test then relies on back() being the stream's.

findings.title: The pass-through compressor duplicates the `data
findings.claim: The pass-through compressor duplicates the `data.size ? std::move(data) : rpc::snd_buf(temporary_buffer<char>())` idiom and the aborting two-argument negotiate() from the neighbouring tracker compressor/factory instead of sharing a helper.

findings.title: The long header comment on the test repeats the commit message's root-cause narrative,…
findings.claim: The long header comment on the test repeats the commit message's root-cause narrative, including internal details such as the `[this] { return send({}); }` hook and stop_send_loop skipping close.

findings.title: stream_close() now waits for the whole outgoing queue to drain before closing the write…
findings.claim: stream_close() now waits for the whole outgoing queue to drain before closing the write buffer, and nothing bounds or cancels this wait.

findings.title: The fix commit does not include its regression test; the test arrives in the next commit
findings.claim: The fix commit does not include its regression test; the test arrives in the next commit.

findings.title: The test's data_sink wrapper overrides only put(std::span<
findings.claim: The test's data_sink wrapper overrides only put(std::span<...>), with no SEASTAR_API_LEVEL guard. The loopback sink it wraps guards that overload with #if SEASTAR_API_LEVEL >= 9 and also implements put(net::packet).

findings.title: The test waits on close_entered_cv with no timeout
findings.claim: The test waits on close_entered_cv with no timeout. If a future regression keeps stream_close() from reaching write_buf.close(), for example because the new queue_drained wait never resolves, the test hangs until the external ctest/test.py timeout instead of failing.

findings.title: test_connected_socket_impl is a thin pass-through that hand-copies every…
findings.claim: test_connected_socket_impl is a thin pass-through that hand-copies every connected_socket_impl virtual. test_socket_impl duplicates the existing rpc_socket_impl and its no-op reuseaddr. buffer_size() is hard-coded to 8192 instead of forwarding to the wrapped sink.

findings.title: hook_capturing_compressor_factory is a second test factory that captures…
findings.claim: hook_capturing_compressor_factory is a second test factory that captures send_empty_frame, next to the existing tracker::factory, which already stores the hook. It mutates itself from a const negotiate() through const_cast, and the server_factory's captured hooks are never used.

findings.title: The name test_sink_state hides what the struct does: it parks data_sink::close() until…
findings.claim: The name test_sink_state hides what the struct does: it parks data_sink::close() until release_close is set, and records whether a put() happened after close. The name gives neither role.

findings.title: In stream_close(), the new comment block says stop_send_loop() waits for…
findings.claim: In stream_close(), the new comment block says stop_send_loop() waits for _sink_closed_future and "nothing else waits" for _outgoing_queue_ready. The old comment that explains the same serialization was kept below the new block. Also, suspend_for_testing() still calls _outgoing_queue_ready.get().

findings.title: The commit message and the PR body describe the same field incident differently
findings.claim: The commit message and the PR body describe the same field incident differently. Commit f545c28a says 'the crash a Scylla node hit'; the PR body says 'This is what two Scylla nodes hit'.
